question: ________ March is celebrated as World Water Day.
solution:
The correct answer is __**22**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• Every year world water day is observed on 22 march around the world.
 
• The objective of the day is to raise awareness of the global water crisis.
 
• The idea for a world water day was put forward in 1992, at the Rio de Janeiro United Nations Conference on Environment and Development.
 
• The theme of world water day 2021 is Valuing water.
